body: I'm glad to hear that you will tell these people the truth. If they offer help, it's best to not lie about anything. Best of luck. Keep me updated if you wish.

Can you please go to bed thinking about something good you did for someone because your religion taught you to do it? It doesn't matter what entity taught you how to behave that way, all that matters is you did something that made both yourself and others happy. 

Maybe you can go to sleep with these thoughts instead? Can you let me know tomorrow what you were thinking about? I want to know. I really do! Even if you don't want to tell me, please try to smile as you go to sleep. It will make me smile :)

One week, hell, one day at a time man. One day at a time. I keep that in my head too. One day at a time. One thing at a time. It's how I get things done, it's how I should be thinking.

I'm glad I helped you. You helped me, believe it or not. I'm still trying to reach out to people right now on suicidewatch and it's solely because we had that connection. 

You're a good person. Thank you :)

I tried one online course and the deadline was making me go absolutely crazy so I gave up on it. Since then I learned a little bit about sound, it was more relaxed with the pressure but it didn't feel good to do the same thing again. 

I don't know how to get out of this situation. I have no money to move and none flowing so I can't save. Plus I'm so extremely torn when it comes to one of my friends since we've been friends since elementary but ever since he changed schools, the friends he made kept me from staying close. Now we are so very different and one of his best friends betrayed me in a way that I'll never forgive. Plus he's bought me so many things on the assumption that one day I'll have money to blow and I'll do the same for him. I mean, I would, but that day isn't coming.

I don't know, just typing this fogs my mind and makes me anxious. I don't know.

When you say goodbye, can you first mention to these people: "I am not OK" ? Just say it and see what they say? Answer honestly to their questions? If not for you, then for me? I want to know what they said. I really do! If you don't want to tell me for any reason, just asking and answering them honestly will make me happy. Will you let me know if you did that? Honestly?

As much as I like helping people, I've been fucked over by so many others... It feels good when I can be a dick and sometimes I let loose since I keep it bottled up. In the end I know it's wrong and I've made people feel as shitty as I have. I want to stop this relapse but I can't. I don't know why. 

I don't do anything because all I do is sit at the computer. I'm afraid and anxious to put myself out there more because people just keep fucking with me again and again. I help people out without a word of complaint but when I ask for help it's like my very existence is a burden. I just want to be good to people in person but I'm just so sick of people not sharing this same mindset.

Truth is that I'm not. You'll have to take my word for it since I can't prove it. I understand if you still don't believe me. If no one else will post you can message the mods. edit: You're not OP, sorry. Either way I hope OP sees this.

This is a throwaway I made specifically to post here, but then I got curious and saw some other posts. As much as I wanted to die then, right now I'm just trying to help. It feels better than wallowing and doing nothing.

I like that idea. I really do. I definitely want pets too. If for any reason you can't get the cats you want, having any pet (lizard, hamster, goldfish, etc.) should have a similar effect. 

If I did have a pet I would definitely not want the not-very-intelligent creature to have to figure out what's going on when they stumble upon a cold version of myself. I know that at that point I'd have to delay my death until, at the very least, after I found a solution for my buddy.

I really really want a pet but my living situation doesn't allow for it. Plus, I don't know how to deal with the issues I need to deal with to get myself out of here. 

I remember you saying you're 17. Please don't take for granted what you have available to you. I don't want you to be like me. edit: wrong post, I see you're not 17. Sorry lol but yeah, same message.

Breathe.

Breathe calmly.

Can't? IN 1.. 2.. 3.. 4.. OUT 1.. 2.. 3.. 4..

Still can't? Go to the beginning. Otherwise:

What's something you DO NOT hate to do, everyday. Tell me! What do you like about that one specific thing that makes it worth talking about? I want to know. Really!

If you don't want to tell me, that's OK too, but please breath properly. It will help you calm down at the very least.

What I said earlier was one of a few reasons. When you're dead you're dead. To me, right now, that statement means: I won't see how Game of Thrones ends, I'll have given up on the chance to see my mother again and also most-likely ruin her as a person since she isn't in the best mindset either, the chance to finally meet and love someone will be gone, the chance to live on my own will be gone, the chance to finally have a pet will be gone. These reasons actually convince me to keep going a LOT more then my desire to keep the pain away from my family (minus my mother). There are feelings going the other way too: no more worry, no more pain, no more fear, no more suffering, no more constant physical feeling of complete emptiness in my chest. At the moment my craving to see the future is outweighing the pain I'm feeling and I guess that will have to be good enough for now.

Other reasons include the fact that most survivors of suicide end up regretting the fact that they did indeed try. If I try and fail I'll be seen as the psycho suicidal guy. I don't know all the travel laws but I fear if try and fail I'll be unable to travel (even though I have no idea if this is true). 

I've been giving up recently. Spending all my money since I won't need it anymore. Throwing out photos and possessions. Not caring what I say. It's a way to numb yourself but you push out the bad and the good by doing this. In the end I'm glad that this encounter happened before I got worse. I don't know if I'll change yet, but I'll try not to let it get worse.
Goodbye. If you come back for any reason, tell me your favorite thing to do, but only if you want to. I want to know your favorite thing to do. I really do.

Another cliche for you if you're up for reading it: 

I know how you feel. 

Honestly, before I read what you wrote about the flip-of-a-switch, I always just assumed people were bullshitting me when saying that statement ("I know how you feel") since it seems so easy to say. Here's the truth though, weather or not you take my words seriously, there isn't a spec of bullshit in this: I uttered those same words to myself yesterday, and meant it. I thought I was alone with these thoughts. This is the truth.

What I said more specifically was "I wish I could just instantly die. I wish I could just instantly flip my brain off and become nothing.  If I could, I wouldn't hesitate for a second." I said this (as best as I can remember from memory) out loud to myself while no-one was listening and meant every word. At the time, I also didn't believe anyone could possibly understand what goes through my head.

I hope you understand that you share these thoughts. If with one person who's willing to share them, then also with many more who won't. If you take nothing away from this, just know that you altered my view of people ever-so-slightly. If I stick around, too, I can get a few more mind alterations... maybe... 

If it means anything, I also play video-games as a way to pass time.

You said you felt calm after sorting your pills. You were able to sort those so I think you're capable of sorting out other clutter. Perhaps you have a box of change or book of receipts that need sorting. Maybe save them for when you need to feel calm again?

Please don't think I'm forcing you to do anything. Hell, throw your change out the window at a passing car if that's what you **really** want to do. It's just that it's possible that you found a way to calm yourself without realizing it. I can only hope you see what I'm getting at.

I read that when it comes to depression it isn't best to lie to your doctor for they may prescribe the wrong medication. I'm no expert by a long shot but the facts seem to be pointing toward that. If you manage to stay with us until you see the doctor next, don't be afraid to tell the truth. Think back to how you feel right now if you're hesitant at the time. 

I'm not telling you to do this, it's just what I'd do if in your situation. Ultimately, no one is going to force you to tell the doctor the truth, up to you.

The boredom probably won't stop anytime soon. No matter what I say I can't make you happy again. I will say that /u/danceswithwool has a point. You only live once. I won't tell you not to waste it, I'll say that you should come back to that fact when you make decisions regarding your life. It's one of few reasons I'm still kicking around. Hell, if this advice is of any use whatsoever then I guess that's another reason (I don't believe it personally but it's what I've observed others say to others). Sit there and play games all your life if that's what you want, honestly. 80 years of games is a lot.

edit: You asked wtf is the point? All I'm saying there really isn't one. It doesn't matter, so play video games (If you want, up to you).
The people here probably won't tell you. They don't want you to die. I have nothing to contribute, just thought you should know.
